open_points.subject: Operator model provider
open_points.text: whatever it records or reads passes through its model provider
open_points.question: Which external model provider receives Registry data, and what trust boundary applies when customer contact data is sent to it?
options: Name one permitted provider and its trust status
Define a configurable set of permitted providers
Treat any operator-selected model provider as permitted
open_points.default_guess: Treat the operator's configured model provider as an owner-approved external processor.

open_points.subject: Personal-data access boundary
open_points.text: whatever it records or reads passes through its model provider ... Personal data — the customer's contact data ... readable by staff only
open_points.question: Does “readable by staff only” describe only Registry API authorization, or does it prohibit the non-staff model provider from processing contact data?
options: It governs API authorization only; the approved model provider may process data for the operator
Only staff may see or process the data, so it must not pass through a model provider
The model provider is explicitly included in the trusted staff boundary
open_points.default_guess: Interpret staff-only as the Registry API rule and permit the owner-approved provider to process operator data.

open_points.subject: Configuration loading at restart
open_points.text: a change takes effect when the instance restarts
open_points.question: What must Registry observably do when required configuration is missing, malformed, internally inconsistent or unreadable at restart?
options: Refuse to start with a configuration error
Start while disabling only the affected capability
Ignore the invalid change and retain a previously valid configuration
open_points.default_guess: Refuse to start and report a configuration error without exposing secret values.
